question: Why do seeming scriptures create doubt in those without awakening?
premises: Those devoid of awakening are made to grasp doubt by seeming scriptures.
Awareness may remain hidden for long but can still awaken.
inference: Seeming scriptures only trouble those lacking awakening, while awareness itself can awaken even after long latency.
plain_english: Those without awakening are vainly made to cling to doubt by mere semblances of scripture; yet awareness, though hidden for long, can still awaken.
